text.title: Learning Speed as Competitive Moat Failure Modes
text.summary: 10 antipatterns observed across deployments, including the agent gotchas of the belief-update pipeline. Each pairs symptom + root-cause + concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: Team can't articulate why they bet on feature X; defends bet emotionally.
antipattern.root-cause: No belief register; assumptions never captured.
antipattern.fix: Maintain templates/belief_update.py register: assumption, confidence, source, last-updated.

antipattern.symptom: Roadmap reflects founder narrative; competitor moves and market data ignored.
antipattern.fix: Require ≥1 outside-view input per strategic decision (competitor move, market data, customer signal).

antipattern.symptom: Bet drags on 18 months with no clear evidence threshold to stop.
antipattern.root-cause: Kill criteria never pre-registered; sunk cost dominates.
antipattern.fix: Every bet records signal + threshold + observation window for kill at start.

antipattern.symptom: Beliefs only re-scored at annual planning; competitor cycles 4x.
antipattern.root-cause: No weekly cadence; learning lives in the annual offsite only.
antipattern.fix: Hold weekly 30-min belief-update ritual; missed weeks count as moat erosion.

antipattern.symptom: Synthesizer generating insights at digest-of-digest-of-digest compression, losing original wording.
antipattern.root-cause: Re-grounding every synthesizer run on the raw events.ndjson is mandatory. Previous digests anchor on prior framing and lose the original signal over time.
antipattern.fix: Feed the weekly-synthesizer the raw events.ndjson every run, never last week's digest.

antipattern.symptom: Memory rot: belief-updater pulled into context-window compaction loses last week's reasoning.
antipattern.root-cause: Persist beliefs.yaml and beliefs.history.ndjson outside the LLM and re-inject on every run. Never rely on LLM memory for belief continuity across sessions.
antipattern.fix: Apply rule beliefs-as-code; the file on disk is the memory, the model is stateless.

antipattern.symptom: Evidence laundering: sonnet rewrites the same event into 3 different "independent" supports for a belief.
antipattern.root-cause: Dedupe by event_id hash before counting independent signals. Three occurrences of the same event do not count as three independent signals.
antipattern.fix: Apply rule belief-mutation-threshold on deduplicated event_ids only.

antipattern.symptom: Hallucinated event_ids: model invents event_42 that does not exist in events.ndjson.
antipattern.root-cause: Run a fact-checker pass that looks up every cited id in events.ndjson before publishing. Uncited event_ids are fabrications.
antipattern.fix: Add the fact-checker pass as a gate before any belief diff is merged.

antipattern.symptom: Token blow-up from dumping 10k events directly into Opus weekly.
antipattern.root-cause: Pre-cluster with haiku, hand 50–100 archetypal events to opus. Full event streams at opus cost is wasteful and counterproductively degrades reasoning quality.
antipattern.fix: Apply rule separate-mechanical-from-judgment-work; haiku clusters, opus judges.

antipattern.symptom: Action-less insight loop: agent surfaces 200 insights per week, no decision_owner, nobody acts.
antipattern.root-cause: Force schema field decision_owner on every event that reaches the belief-updater. Drop events without an owner rather than surfacing them without action.
antipattern.fix: Make decision_owner a required schema field; apply rule decision-count-and-reversal-metric to measure output, not insights.
